title: What Is Redundant at High Resolution? Efficient Attention and Feed-Forward Design for All-in-One Image Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2611.33636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-scale architectures are widely adopted in all-in-one image restoration (AIO-IR) to capture larger-scale context at low-resolution stages and refine details at high-resolution (HR) stages. However, processing spatially large feature maps at HR stages incurs substantial computational costs and memory traffic, making efficient HR processing challenging. To address this challenge, we propose High-resolution Global-Local Restoration (HiGLR), an efficient multi-scale AIO-IR network grounded in an analysis of spatial redundancy in self-attention and convolutional feed-forward networks (ConvFFNs). Specifically, this analysis identifies three key redundancies: per-query readout at the finest-scale stage, key routing across neighboring queries at intermediate stages, and spatial mixing in the expanded feature spaces of ConvFFNs. Accordingly, HiGLR replaces costly self-attention at the finest-scale stage with a learned input-independent ker

translated_title: 高分辨率下什么才是冗余的？面向一体化图像修复的高效注意力与前馈网络设计
translated_abstract: 多尺度架构被广泛应用于一体化图像修复（AIO-IR）中，用于在低分辨率阶段捕获更大尺度的上下文信息，并在高分辨率（HR）阶段细化细节。然而，在高分辨率阶段处理空间尺寸庞大的特征图会带来巨大的计算成本和内存开销，使得高效的高分辨率处理极具挑战。为应对这一难题，我们提出了高分辨率全局-局部修复网络（HiGLR），这是一种高效的多尺度AIO-IR网络，其设计建立在对自注意力机制和卷积前馈网络（ConvFFN）中空间冗余进行分析的基础之上。具体而言，该分析识别出三类关键冗余：最细尺度阶段的逐查询读取、中间阶段跨相邻查询的键路由，以及ConvFFN扩展特征空间中的空间混合。据此，HiGLR用一种学习得到的、与输入无关的核来替换最细尺度阶段代价高昂的自注意力计算……（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过剖析自注意力与卷积前馈网络中的三类空间冗余，提出高效多尺度一体化图像修复网络HiGLR，显著降低了高分辨率阶段的计算与内存开销。
en_tdlr: By identifying three key spatial redundancies in self-attention and ConvFFNs, HiGLR is proposed as an efficient multi-scale all-in-one image restoration network that substantially reduces the computational and memory costs of high-resolution processing.
